description: A writer: asks the runtime's own agent, once, for a project's program — its first, or its next — in the copy of the project it is handed, in the words trama itself has for it. Named as a making's createWith, or an update's updateWith.

parameters.prompt?: string: what is asked of the program — handed by the runner to whoever writes one, as the three that follow are
parameters.program?: string: the program it is written from, whole (it is program.ts in the copy, too) — none, at a project's making
parameters.kept?: boolean: whether what is made beside the program, in the copy, is kept with it
parameters.types?: string: the API a program has, as its author is shown it

returns.program?: string: the whole of the program
returns.unwritable?: string: why there is no program, where the model says there is none to be written
returns.nothing?: string: why nothing was written, where it was run with nothing to write

input.prompt: A writer of programs: named where a project is made or updated (createWith, updateWith).
